question: What egress rate (per-GB price) does the USD 200 IBM Cloud credit buy, and when does that credit expire?
why: The first-party IBM Cloud free page states the USD 200 credit but neither its expiry nor the per-GB public egress rate; without both numbers the credit cannot be converted to a TiB figure. The VPC pricing page and promo terms were not read as first-party pages in this unit.
